recognize_zh: 低倍下左側為脾被膜與白髓濾泡，右側為相對分界清楚的病灶，由許多充滿血液、彼此吻合的囊狀血管腔與乳頭狀突起組成；位於脾實質內的這種海綿狀血管病灶是 littoral cell angioma 的低倍樣貌。
features: Splenic capsule (left edge) and a white pulp lymphoid follicle for orientation
Adjacent vascular lesion composed of anastomosing, cystic, blood-filled channels
Papillary projections and irregular septa within the dilated spaces
Congested red pulp between the follicle and the lesion
Lesion relatively circumscribed; no solid sheets or necrosis at this power
describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows the capsule and a white pulp follicle adjacent to a relatively circumscribed vascular lesion. The lesion consists of anastomosing, cystically dilated blood-filled channels with papillary projections and thin septa. No solid growth or necrosis is identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma, in conjunction with the immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Cavernous hemangioma has thin-walled spaces lined by flat endothelium without papillary tufts of plump lining cells.
SANT shows multiple angiomatoid nodules separated by dense fibrosclerotic bands with a concentric architecture.
Peliosis has blood-filled cavities without a lining of plump papillary cells and without a discrete neoplasm.
Angiosarcoma shows infiltrative borders, solid areas and cytologic atypia.
